findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: source_get_alternatives, source_get_project · Private data: source_dataset_info · Public sink: source_compare_projects.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: source_get_alternatives, source_get_project · Private data: source_dataset_info · Public sink: source_compare_projects

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
